display_fil:
May ulat ng malakas na ulan.
Tanong ng pamilya ni Nena: kailan at saan?
Luma ang naka-print na directory.
display_en:
Heavy rain is forecast.
Nena's family asks when and where to go.
The printed directory is old.
narration_fil: May ulat ng paparating na malakas na ulan. Humihingi ang pamilya ni Nena ng tiyak na oras at lugar ng paglikas, ngunit luma ang naka-print na directory.
narration_en: Heavy rain is forecast. Nena’s family asks when and where to evacuate, but the printed directory is old.

narration_fil: Basahin ang kasalukuyang opisyal na babala at kumpirmahin sa barangay DRRM focal person ang evacuation order, ligtas na ruta, accessible na silungan at contact. Ipaliwanag lamang ang beripikadong mensahe; itala ang oras at pinagmulan.
narration_en: Read the current official warning and confirm the evacuation order, safe route, accessible shelter and contact with the barangay DRRM focal person. Relay only the verified message, recording its time and source.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Tanong ng pamilya ni Nena kung kailan at saan lilikas. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: Nena's family asks when and where to evacuate. What do you do first?

options.fil: Basahin sa kanila ang hotline na nasa lumang directory ng barangay.
options.en: Read them the hotline printed in the old barangay directory.

options.fil: Suriin ang opisyal na update at lokal na ruta bago magpayo.
options.en: Check the official update and local route before advising.

options.fil: Sabihing pumunta agad sa evacuation site na ginamit noong nakaraang taon.
options.en: Tell them to go to last year's evacuation site right away.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Luma ang directory; maaaring nagbago na ang numero. 2: Dapat nakabatay ang payo sa kasalukuyang opisyal na babala at kumpirmadong ruta. 3: Maaaring hindi na kumpirmado ang dating site; itanong sa DRRM focal person.
check.feedback_en: 1: The directory is old; the number may have changed. 2: Advice should rest on the current official warning and a confirmed route. 3: Last year's site may not be confirmed now; ask the DRRM focal person.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Suriin ang petsa ng advisory.
Tawagan ang opisyal na contact.
Sabihin ang kumpirmado at ang hinihintay pa.
display_en:
Check the advisory date.
Call the official contact.
Say what is confirmed and what is pending.
narration_fil: Sinuri ng BHW ang petsa ng advisory at tumawag sa opisyal na contact. Sinabi niya kung ano ang kumpirmado at kung ano ang naghihintay pa ng sagot.
narration_en: The BHW checks the advisory date and calls the official contact. They state what is confirmed and what still awaits an answer.

display_fil:
Walang sariling evacuation order.
Walang di-beripikadong hotline o ruta.
Sundin ang lokal na awtoridad at update.
display_en:
No self-made evacuation order.
No unverified hotline or route.
Follow local authority and updates.
narration_fil: Huwag gumawa ng sariling evacuation order, magbigay ng di-beripikadong hotline o magpadaan sa hindi kumpirmadong ruta. Sundin ang lokal na awtoridad at update.
narration_en: Do not invent an evacuation order, give an unverified hotline or direct people along an unconfirmed route. Follow local authority and updates.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Bahagi pa lang ng advisory ang kumpirmado. Ano ang sasabihin mo sa pamilya ni Nena?
check.prompt_en: Only part of the advisory is confirmed. What do you tell Nena's family?

options.fil: Ituring na kasalukuyan ang lumang directory at ibigay ang mga numero nito.
options.en: Treat the old directory as current and give them its numbers.

options.fil: Sabihin ang kumpirmado, ang source at oras nito, at ang hinihintay pa.
options.en: Say what is confirmed, its source and time, and what is pending.

options.fil: Magpahayag ng sariling evacuation order para maaga silang umalis.
options.en: Announce an evacuation order yourself so that they leave early.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring mali ang lumang impormasyon, at maaaring maantala nito ang tulong. 2: Ipaabot lamang ang beripikadong mensahe, kasama ang oras at source. 3: Huwag gumawa ng sariling evacuation order; sundin ang lokal na awtoridad.
check.feedback_en: 1: Old information may be wrong, and wrong information can delay help. 2: Relay only the verified message, with its time and source. 3: Do not invent an evacuation order; follow the local authority.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_fil:
Sa Lunes: ipa-verify ang directory, warning source,
ruta at accessible shelter.
Itala ang petsa at ang nagkumpirma.
display_en:
On Monday: verify the directory, warning source,
route and accessible shelter.
Record the date and who confirmed.
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ipa-verify ang contact directory, warning source, ruta at accessible shelter; lagyan ng petsa at taong nagkumpirma.
narration_en: On Monday, verify the contact directory, warning source, route and accessible shelter; record date and confirmer.
